mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 5-day returns in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression framework.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 107.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening supply-side activity, which may trigger a market reassessment of inflation risks and prompt a flight to quality, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 107.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 250.0 in a single month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in 60% or more of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 250.0, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust aggregate demand, which strengthens corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model with interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% while payroll growth remains above 150k signals a tight labor market that may force wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate, signals a supply-side contraction coupled with weakening labor demand, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression framework.
